outcome: A leveler with level counters in the N1-N2 range has the base power and toughness and abilities of that striation.
A leveler with N3 or more level counters has the base power and toughness and abilities of the N3+ striation.
A leveler can activate its level up ability regardless of how many level counters it has.
A leveler with fewer level counters than N1 has the power and toughness of its uppermost box.
A leveler card outside the battlefield has the power and toughness of its uppermost box.
